signal: p1 = stacked probability of the blend 0.5 rank-1 family (recommend_v23)
rule: maximise Youden's J (sensitivity + specificity - 1) for predicting a miss (no gold family in the top 5) by p1 < t; candidates are midpoints between consecutive distinct p1 values; ties -> smaller t
chosen_on: development queries only: retrieval_v2/evaluation/queries_v2.csv (55 queries; the v2.2 lambda was also selected on this set). The independent test queries and gold were not read.
feature_conflict_rule: fixed a priori: fires when the extracted features conflict with every one of the top five families; no tunable value, so nothing was chosen for it
